content:
City crews cleaned up the creek running through Laredo's Three Points neighborhood on Thursday, November 5, after residents complained the area had gone unmaintained for years, according to KGNS.

The creek runs through a residential area near the intersection of Market and Arkansas streets. Residents said overgrown weeds and vegetation and trash and debris littering the sidewalk had piled up, and some tenants were considering moving out because of the conditions. Neighbors also said there had been a bee problem in the area at one point.

Neighbor Tom Harmon told KGNS he had called the city about the creek but could not get anything done. The cleanup came after District 2 Council Member Ricardo Rangel contacted city management, and crews were sent out on Thursday to maintain the area.

KGNS did not report an itemized list of what was removed, or the cost of the work.

Sources: KGNS.

title: Three Points Creek Cleaned Up After Residents Raise Concerns
